files.README.md:
# Mathematics

112 concepts across eight subjects, adapted from the local math/studio knowledge graph (`math/content/math.json`).

Open the complete map or choose a subject in Explorer. Double-click a concept and follow its note link. Notes link to related concepts within this workspace. Subject views retain immediate prerequisites from other subjects.

Definitions and relationships are adapted from the corresponding English concept notes. These compact reference notes are not a replacement for full mathematical treatments.
